title: A stale manual authority write whose image was superseded gets an internal error instead of the retryable conflict
outcome: In a test state with no writer thread, a manual authority write whose capture went stale and whose image was superseded reaches the caller as the same conflict as the non-stale order, so the outcome no longer depends on timing.
acceptance: A stale manual authority write whose image was superseded gets an internal error instead of the retryable conflict is done
